data.title: Welcome
data.text: Welcome to the example course. It shows how a course is built from JSON files.

data.title: One file per chapter
text: A course is a course.json that lists its chapters.
Each chapter is a file with an ordered list of blocks.
Nothing else is needed: no database, no editor, no asset.

data.title: End of chapter
data.text: The next chapter shows one block of every available type.
